name: Axonius
description: Let agents search Axonius's devices and users, correlated across every tool Axonius collects from, read one device or user, and list saved queries and fields. Read-only. For reconciling device lists and finding unmanaged or out-of-date devices.
identity: The API key and secret of an Axonius service account made for agents. Agents see what that account's role may see.

setup.title: Create a service account for agents
setup.body: Axonius asks for a service account dedicated to API access. Give it a role with permission to use the API and to view devices and users, and nothing that can run or change enforcements; agents never run enforcements, and no tool here does. Then copy the service account's API key and API secret.

setup.title: Enter your Axonius address
setup.body: The host name you open Axonius at, such as acme.on.axonius.com, without https:// or a path.

fields.label: Axonius address
fields.help: The host name you open Axonius at, without https:// or a path.

capabilities.label: Read devices and users
capabilities.description: Search devices and users with AQL, read one device or user, and list saved queries and fields.
capabilities.note: Read-only. Reaches every device and user the service account can see, with what each source reports about it.

revoke: In Axonius, open the service account and reset its API key and secret, or delete the account. Agents lose access to Axonius at once.

tools.name: axonius_search_devices
tools.description: Search Axonius devices with an AQL query, as Axonius's query wizard writes it, such as ("specific_data.data.hostname" == regex("IDC-", "i")), and read the fields you name, correlated across every source Axonius collects from. Answers one page and the cursor for the next; pass it back as cursor while next is not null.

query.description: An AQL query; every one when left out

fields.description: The fields to read, by field name; axonius_list_fields lists them

limit.description: How many per page, at most 100
limit.name: page.limit

cursor.description: The next cursor from the page before
cursor.name: page.cursor

tools.name: axonius_search_users
tools.description: Search Axonius users with an AQL query, as Axonius's query wizard writes it, such as ("specific_data.data.username" == regex("ann", "i")), and read the fields you name, correlated across every source Axonius collects from. Answers one page and the cursor for the next; pass it back as cursor while next is not null.

query.description: An AQL query; every one when left out

fields.description: The fields to read, by field name; axonius_list_fields lists them

limit.description: How many per page, at most 100
limit.name: page.limit

cursor.description: The next cursor from the page before
cursor.name: page.cursor

tools.name: axonius_get_asset
tools.description: Read everything Axonius holds on one device or user, by its internal_axon_id from a search, with each source's own data.

tools.name: axonius_list_fields
tools.description: List the fields devices or users have in this Axonius, from every source, for naming fields in a search and writing AQL.

tools.name: axonius_list_saved_queries
tools.description: List the saved queries in Axonius, such as the ones behind dashboards and reports, with their AQL to reuse in a search.

asset_type.description: Only saved queries of devices or users

offset.description: How many to skip, starting at 0
